LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketDesc: Choose a quantity and stall. Haulers deliver the items; nothing moves until collected. Full stalls wait for space.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketUnavailable: This item is no longer available for hauling.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketStale: Return to the item's original map to send it.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketNotOwned: This item or its storage is not player-owned.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketForbidden: Allow this item before sending it to market.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketAlreadyQueued: This stack is already fully queued for delivery.
LanguageData.ARIO_SendMarketNoStall: Build a market stall on this map first.
